opportunities.name: Flux Shift Refund
opportunities.objective: Measure net mana spent and W/E hit reliability.
opportunities.mechanic: W detonated by an ability refunds that ability's cost plus 60 mana; E prioritizes W marked targets and has 0.75 AP. Luden/AP penetration supports the W/E magic sequence while Cosmic helps leave. Q remains physical even with its AP ratio.
opportunities.requiredState: W sticks to the intended champion and E chooses it without exposing Ezreal.
opportunities.failure: W miss changes E targeting and removes the refund; AP loses attack damage.
opportunities.test: Measure net mana spent and W/E hit reliability; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: W attachment alone does not deal the detonation damage.

opportunities.name: Mystic Haste Survival
opportunities.objective: Count E reavailability across a fixed number of Q hits.
opportunities.mechanic: Each Q hit reduces ability cooldowns by 1.5 seconds. Shojin and haste support repeated landing opportunities; Trinity adds cast-attack value and Muramana supplies earned mana/AD. Frozen Heart survival buys more Q attempts while Serylda supports physical Q damage.
opportunities.requiredState: Have an unobstructed Q lane and a completed Tear transformation. Record the earned Muramana transformation and finite max mana.
opportunities.failure: Front-unit interception or missed Q removes the proposed cooldown acceleration.
opportunities.test: Count E reavailability across a fixed number of Q hits; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The extracted Q tooltip does not itself prove Spellblade/on-hit transmission through Q; log it.

ruledOut.reason: Q explicitly deals physical damage despite AP scaling.

unknowns: P attack-speed-per-stack is unresolved; Q item-hit inheritance needs live verification rather than memory.
StatFormula annotations remain symbolic; verify the affected stat basis before numerical comparison.

builds.summary: Measure net mana spent and W/E hit reliability.
builds.goal: Measure net mana spent and W/E hit reliability.
builds.hypothesis: W detonated by an ability refunds that ability's cost plus 60 mana; E prioritizes W marked targets and has 0.75 AP. Luden/AP penetration supports the W/E magic sequence while Cosmic helps leave. Q remains physical even with its AP ratio.
testPlan: Required state: W sticks to the intended champion and E chooses it without exposing Ezreal.
Measure net mana spent and W/E hit reliability; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: W miss changes E targeting and removes the refund; AP loses attack damage.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: W attachment alone does not deal the detonation damage.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Luden's Echo, Cosmic Drive, Shadowflame, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

Detonating with an Ability refunds the Mana cost of that Ability plus [60] Mana.
